thesis: This episode argues that the anime genre is experiencing a significant renaissance, with major established companies like Netflix and EA waking up to the opportunity alongside specialized studios. It posits that success in this space relies on deep adherence to the medium's specific character design and archetypes, citing examples like Mahoyo and Mojoya which have generated hits by getting these fundamentals right.
